title: Original callbacks, guard compatibility and same-run handoff for the unique channel
statement: Two continuous engineering packages, six outcomes: the unique channel is exercised through main's ORIGINAL NativeProductAttempt methods (recordFact / readPayload / beforeNativeWrite / nativeWriteDecision, the implementation behind attachCallbacks), including void/throw/late guard layering, command-authority independence, temporary detach vs terminal vs EOF, bounded pressure and a same-run handoff record. The channel module is unchanged. Original Application/QuestionBroker Work recovery, native effects, installed bytes and product slot release remain NOT_REACHED.

inner.intentCorrelation: intent-<module salt>-<n>; business command ids cmd-orig-1/cmd-succ-1/cmd-succ-2/cmd-handoff preserved
inner.payloadRefs: payload:<sha256 of canonical JSON>; caller-side local and coordinator-side refs are identical by content addressing

outcomes.title: Unique channel's three callbacks via original methods
outcomes.implementation: NativeProductAttempt.recordFact/readPayload/nativeWriteDecision used as the caller callbacks; endpoint injected as the post-registration state (no launch/spawn)
outcomes.positive: original Store receipt seq == row seq; original payload body; one original guard decision per intent
outcomes.negative: foreign source refused before any receipt; missing index/current refuse
outcomes.notReached: attachCallbacks as returned by launch() (requires native spawn); Application/QuestionBroker Wiring

outcomes.title: Original fresh guard void/throw/late semantics
outcomes.implementation: original void beforeNativeWrite + explicit decision wrapper layering
outcomes.positive: wrapped decision allows exactly once; consumed admission cannot be reused
outcomes.negative: bare void never allows; throw, wrong recorded body, stale current refuse

outcomes.title: Existing RPC and command-authority compatibility
outcomes.implementation: typed recovery transport; command identity/epoch checks stay in the original service
outcomes.positive: command refusal demonstrated with callback lease already at generation>=2
outcomes.negative: foreign-attempt command refused; legal command without a live child is a typed refusal, never a success
outcomes.notReached: feed/cancel through a launched native Runner; B raw-cancel foreign-source residual (B-owned)

outcomes.title: Temporary detach, terminal and succession with original callbacks
outcomes.implementation: two original-method callers over the same endpoint; main terminal close
outcomes.positive: successor continues the same attempt; fresh intent gets its own original decision
outcomes.negative: pending write indeterminate and not migrated; terminal closes a pending record; input EOF is not a shutdown (no ACK, no exit frame)
outcomes.notReached: same original Work recovery to check/currentCandidate/manualaccept

outcomes.title: Namespace, backpressure and bounded diagnostics
outcomes.implementation: module bounds applied to the original callback path
outcomes.positive: slow original sink drains a burst; 64 facts admitted then capacity restored
outcomes.negative: refusing original sink -> typed ack-failure with no Store row; missing caller-local payload refused; 65th fact capacity
outcomes.notReached: product scheduler 2/4 slots and full resource barrier

outcomes.title: Same-run physical/persistent handoff record
outcomes.implementation: RunHandoffRecord built from an actual run; no candidate/accept gate
outcomes.positive: attempt/producer/receipt==Store row/payload/intent nonce/guard count/resources recorded and checked
outcomes.negative: record carries explicit NOT_REACHED/NOT_TESTED/NOT_INSTALLED scope; no business frame and no acceptance artifact
outcomes.notReached: original Application Work/question/answer/native_applied, recovered candidate/manualaccept, slot release, installed/native facts
